status.description: free text: the authored lifecycle word (`active`, `done`); the archetype declares no vocabulary for it.

relationships.description: Absent when the author declared none; the frontmatter schemas do not require the key, and the model must not require what the schema does not (FR-011-AC-15).

body.description: free text: the whole authored body; the archetype declares no `body_extraction`.

description:
Plan record (archetype `Plan`). The authored plan: its scope, its tracks and
its gates. It carries nothing about an execution of that plan — no start, no
finish, no outcome (FR-013).
